decisions.reason: As a close-to-core waterproof safety range in a growing market, it likely embodies meaningful development effort and visible commitment, so management would tend to retain it unless clear sustained failure were evident.

The electrostatic-dissipative occupational shoe fits the firm's established protective-footwear competence and announced innovation path, making management more likely to continue it and treat any underperformance as temporary or segment-specific.
A safety shoe series sits very near the firm's core business, so prior investment, portfolio fit, and the need to justify the launch make withdrawal within the next year relatively unlikely.
